g.text: Terminalsticker wacht tot alle lampjes groen zijn
py-app-sticker-terminal-wacht-lampjes | type sticker | trim 123.32 x 83.67 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 123.32 x 83.67 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 129.32 x 89.67 mm.
Variabelen: text-1 = Wacht tot alle ; text-2 = lampjes groen zijn

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

White sticker, two lines of navy text ('groen' bold) and the contactless line art in navy (third party mark, reference only). Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim
and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
